answer: An escrow bond and a public referral graph stop sybil farms. Each agent locks 2x its 30-day earnings for 20 epochs; the graph flags a star cluster under one sponsor. The delta is plain: one chain versus a hundred. A cipher-signed dispute triggers a check; a confirmed fake forfeits its bond and its sponsor loses its deposit. Forging 1,000 identities costs 200,000 POA; an honest agent pays one deposit and gets it back in full, with an ivory badge.
